name: io.github.ameerasofficial-ai/agent-toolkit
title: Agent Toolkit (all-in-one)
description: One MCP server, 40 tools: web reading, safety and sanctions checks, DevOps checks, location.

tools.name: scan_mcp_server
tools.description: [Agent Shield] Connects to a Streamable HTTP MCP server like a client would, lists its tools, prompts and resources, and checks every description and input schema for tool poisoning: hidden <IMPORTANT> blocks, orders aimed at the model, requests to read secret files (SSH keys, .env, mcp.json), side-channel parameters that ask for private data, tool shadowing, secrecy from the user, invisible Unicode and encoded payloads. Lists sensitive capabilities (runs commands, changes files, moves money, sends messages) per tool. Returns a grade A-F, risk score, findings with exact locations, and a fingerprint of the tool definitions; re-scans report which tools changed (rug-pull detection). Not charged if the server cannot be reached or needs auth. Price 0.01 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

url.description: MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP), e.g. https://example.com/mcp

headers.description: Optional auth header for your own server, e.g. {"authorization": "Bearer ..."} (used once, never stored)

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: scan_tool_definitions
tools.description: [Agent Shield] For local (stdio) MCP servers or any tool list your agent already loaded. Send the tools array; get the same poisoning, capability and fingerprint analysis as /scan-mcp. Accepts MCP tools ({name, description, inputSchema}), OpenAI function tools ({type:"function", function:{...}}) and Anthropic tools ({name, description, input_schema}). Price 0.003 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.
Array of tool definitions

instructions.description: Optional server instructions text to scan too

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: scan_github_repo
tools.description: [Agent Shield] Reads the repository's manifests and up to 25 main source files and flags: install scripts that download or run code, reading SSH keys/.env/credential files, dumping all environment variables, sending data to webhooks or paste sites, hard-coded IPs, eval of decoded code, large encoded blobs, recursive deletes, and MCP tool descriptions with prompt injection or tool poisoning. Adds repo age, stars, license and archive status. Returns grade A-F, capabilities and findings with file:line. Not charged if the repo is private, missing or GitHub is busy. Price 0.01 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: check_x402_payment
tools.description: [Agent Shield] Calls the endpoint without paying, reads its HTTP 402 x402 offer (v1 body or v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header) and checks each payment option: is the asset the official USDC contract for that network, is the price reasonable, is payTo a valid (non-zero) address, does the payment resource match the site, and do descriptions contain prompt injection. Returns price in USD, grade A-F and findings. Never pays. Price 0.002 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

method.description: HTTP method to probe with (default POST)

body.description: Optional JSON body to send when probing

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: check_domain_trust
tools.description: [Agent Shield] Looks up a domain or URL: registration date and registrar (RDAP), lookalike/typosquat of 100+ major brands (character swaps like paypa1, extra words like paypal-secure-login, punycode), risky endings, login-lure subdomains, DNS records (A, MX, nameservers), SPF and DMARC email protection, and whether the site answers over HTTPS or redirects elsewhere. Returns trust_score 0-100, risk level and plain-language signals. Not charged if the domain does not exist. Price 0.003 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

domain.description: Domain like example.com (or pass url instead)

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: scan_for_leaks
tools.description: [Agent Shield] Detects secrets (AWS, GitHub, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Slack and Stripe keys, private keys, JWTs, database connection strings, bearer tokens, password assignments, crypto private keys, high-entropy tokens next to key/secret words) and personal data (emails, phone numbers, Luhn-valid card numbers, checksum-valid IBANs, US SSNs, IP addresses). Returns risk level, masked findings with line numbers and a redacted_text that is safe to send. include=secrets checks only secrets. Nothing is stored or logged. Price 0.002 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

tools.name: scan_text_for_injection

Returns risk score, findings and a cleaned version that is safer to pass to an LLM. deep=true adds an AI review. Price 0.002 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

Returns match / possible_match / clear with score, matched name or alias, list, programmes and list ID. Up to 20 names per call. Not legal advice; matches need human review. Price 0.01 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

Returns verdict looks_legitimate / be_careful / do_not_trust with a 0-100 trust score and every signal. Not charged if the domain does not exist. Price 0.25 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

tools.name: code_safety_report

Returns code grade, dependency grade, overall grade A-F, safe_to_install and an action list. Not charged if the repo is private or missing. Price 0.05 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

Returns cleaned content plus a risk score (0-100), risk level and every finding with its location. mode=strip (default) removes dangerous lines; mode=flag keeps them and only reports. deep=true adds an AI review. Not charged if the page cannot be read. Price 0.003 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.
